items.html: Afterward he returns to take NRN and Chaya that are higher, from the Supernal Aba and Ima themselves, and not from Yeshsut and Tevuna; and they must return to a second, higher Katnut and Gadlut. Understand this. And afterward he takes from Arich himself, and then the aspect of Yechida is completed in him. Understand this greatly.
